## Breve uses half-and-half

**MUST.** A Breve MUST be made with HalfAndHalf.

- Governs: [Breve](classes/c-breve.md)
- Verification: supported (written by the owner)
- Refines: [Milk drinks have milk](rules.md#rule-milk-drinks-have-milk)
- Source: [Vertex Coffee house guide > Breve, line 9](sources.md#loc-vertex-coffee-house-guide-q2hn8f)
  > A breve must use half-and-half, never whole milk.

<a id="rule-milk-drinks-have-milk"></a>
## Milk drinks have milk

**MUST.** A MilkDrink MUST contain a milk ingredient.

- Governs: [MilkDrink](classes/c-milk-drink.md)
- Verification: supported (written by the owner)
- Source: [Vertex Coffee house guide > Milk drinks, line 5](sources.md#loc-vertex-coffee-house-guide-bdsph9)
  > Every milk drink must contain milk or cream.
